summary: Small bush-edge car park with several cars parked, no homes nearby.
reasons: Only university buildings 23 m or more away

best_section.where: Eastern end of the small car park at the bush edge

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the south and east; nearest buildings are university blocks 23 m or more away, none residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Reached from the sealed campus car park on the west; cars parked along the strip show it is usable, room for a van looks tight.
drivers.traffic: Low; campus parking area with daytime comings and goings.
drivers.convention: Several cars and a parked vehicle at the east end, so a van would not stand out.
